# CI test-runner requirements — full transitive closure, hash-pinned.
# Regenerate: update versions below, then for each package fetch every release
# file digest from https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json (or run
# `pip download <name>==<v> -d /tmp/d && pip hash /tmp/d/*`).
# pytest 9.1.1 needs Python >= 3.10 and pulls pygments, which is why the pin sat
# at 8.3.5 until the floor moved to 3.12 (#252: GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g has no 8.x
# backport). Both matrix legs still run the SAME pytest — that invariant is why
# no environment marker selects a version here.
# At floor 3.12 the `python_version < "3.11"` conditionals are dead: exceptiongroup
# and tomli are no longer reachable and were removed rather than left as decoration.
